```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 6M2

```{r}
#| label: data_define
# X -> Z -> Y
# Simulated data with a strong collinearity between X and Z
N = 100
X = rnorm(N, 0, 1)
Z = rnorm(N, 4 * X, .5)
Y = rnorm(N, 0.5 * Z, 1)
ddd = data.frame(X, Y, Z)
```

```{r}
#| label: plots
# Z vs X
ggplot(ddd, aes(X, Z)) + 
geom_point() + 
labs(title = "Z vs X" )
# Y vs Z
ggplot(ddd, aes(Z, Y)) +
geom_point(color = "blue") +
labs(title = "Y vs Z")
```

```{r}
#| label: lm_model
# lm Y <- X + Z
lm_1 = lm(formula = Y ~ X + Z, data = ddd)
summary(lm_1)
```
